decisions.reason: The vacuum thermoforming unit has had its own page for two consecutive years, which signals sustained investment and public commitment to the firm's equipment line, so management would persist with it even if results are modest.
The orthopedic shoe last was launched in 2024 with a dedicated page, so it is too recent to judge, and weak early results can still be attributed to market ramp-up, which favors continued commitment.

The post-curing unit is only mentioned rather than featured, so the visible commitment is lower, but it fits the firm's announced direction in digital manufacturing equipment and is new enough that management would give it more time.
